lines.en: I travel in hops.
One push of the hind legs, a long leap.
The swamp mud is soft. I like it.
Every hop throws up water.
Crouch, then spring.
My throat sac swells and falls.
I crouch on the lily pad's edge.
Ripples spread from my feet.

lines.zh: 我从一块湿地跳到另一块。
lines.en: From one wet patch to the next.
I shift toward deeper water.

lines.zh: 身体压得很低，随时能跳。
lines.en: Low body, ready to leap.
The slime lets me move more lightly.
I avoid the weeds that snag.
I push forward on my forelegs.

lines.zh: 我踩过浮萍，浮萍沉下去。
lines.en: Duckweed sinks under my feet.
One more hop. Not far.
Only my throat stirs, softly.
Only my throat pulses.
Wingbeats, close by.
The swamp water is murky.

lines.zh: 我在等有东西靠近水边。
lines.en: Waiting for something to come to the edge.
Mud water soaks my belly; just right.
My eyes stay on the water.
I gulp down a mouthful of air.
Mosquitoes circle overhead.
My legs have gone numb.
Cheeks puffed, I wait for a bug to pass.
No one knows I'm here.
A small shift for a better angle.
The reeds sway in the wind.
I've drawn my hind legs in.
A waterbird lands far off.
You're standing too close to the water.
My tongue reaches a long way.

lines.zh: 你听见我鼓下巴的声音了？
lines.en: Did you hear my throat swell?
I've the patience of one meal.
Don't move. Just for a moment.
The swamp swallows all sorts.
You're going to step down, aren't you.
Your ankle is just one bite.

lines.zh: 水面能把你的重量藏住。
lines.en: Water hides how heavy you are.
Step back and I'll relax.

lines.zh: 水边的泥很软，你的脚会陷。
lines.en: This bank is soft. Your feet will sink.
I'm not usually this patient.
A sound squeezes from my swollen throat.
A gash opens across my back.
I drag my leg back into the mud.
One hind leg won't work.
I crouch to guard my belly.
I can jump one more time.
Water flows past the wound.
My throat pulses with my panting.
The pain launches me out of the mud.
I'll wait for one more chance.
An insect flew past.
That smells wrong; I won't touch it.
Living. Something that struggles.
Throw it in the water. I'll get it.
Why is your hand coming down?
I never eat bread.
That's too big to swallow.
There are plenty of small bugs here.
Don't wave it. I'm watching.
I'm not that hungry right now.
It's the smell of blood that brings me.
Bring your finger a little closer.
I've raised my jaw.
It has to touch the water.
I'm waiting for it to drop.
Just a hair out of reach.
You stepped on my hind leg.
I sprang out from your feet.
Too crowded. Even the water's still.
I slipped into the water.
You tripped me; move aside.
I'm flat on the ground. Very small.
Push me and I sink lower.
You got splashed. Sorry.
I sank a little into the mud.
Crowd me more and I'll leap away.
That has to wait for the rainy season.

lines.zh: 这声音就是给同类听的。
lines.en: This call is for my own kind.
There are other bullfrogs here.
We don't discuss that in the water.
I only want a good stretch of water.
This body isn't ready.
I'll dive and not come up.
My call is more useful than an answer.
Don't speak into my ear.
I turned and hopped away.

lines.zh: 啪一声，它就到了我嘴里。
lines.en: A snap, and it's in my mouth.
Not enough for a bite; I drop it.
Not living. I won't eat it.
I push it into the water.
One curl of my tongue and I spit it out.
I swallowed and it stuck.
This can sit under me.
That won't fit in my mouth.
I stepped on it and it sank.
Just leave it where it is.
My tongue is ready.
My tongue can reach you now.
Bend down one more time.
One ripple and I know.
Your foot has stepped into my mud.
One step back and you're out of reach.
My hind legs are drawn in.
My hind legs are already coiled.
You won't hear me move.
Whatever you do, don't look back.
The water hides me well.
My throat is swelling.
You looked down. Good.
I'll wait another half moment.
The reeds hide my body.
Only one movement left.
My eyes haven't closed once.
Your knees bent a little.
A little closer and I reach.
The whole pool smells of me.
My tongue snaps around your wrist!
I bite down, hard.
I bring my whole body down on you.
This one drags you toward the water.
My jaws are locked tight.
You broke free. I fell back.
I got a mouthful of bracer.
I bite and drag it toward the water.
Kick me and I let go.
I dropped back into the water.
I surface out of the mud.
The swamp water ripples gently.
I crouch beneath a reed.
Water still clings to my skin.

lines.zh: 这里安静得很适合伏击。
lines.en: Quiet here. Good for an ambush.
I swell my throat once.

lines.zh: 沼泽里回荡着我的低鸣。
lines.en: My low call echoes through the swamp.
There are many bugs in this water.
I test the power of my hind legs.
This swamp is mine.
Fire bakes my wet skin.

lines.zh: 我摔在硬地上，弹了一下。
lines.en: I hit hard ground and bounced.
Muddy water in my mouth. I panic.

lines.zh: 爆炸把水和泥一起掀开。
lines.en: The blast threw up water and mud.
The arrow still quivers; I can't pull it out.

lines.zh: 那道光让我的皮肤发麻。
lines.en: That light made my skin prickle.

lines.zh: 我在水里蹲了很久没吃到。
lines.en: I've crouched here long without a catch.
The water carries a charge; I kick away.
Falling, and the water's gone.
